description: SafeRest Renewal Mattress Protectors/Pads provide Luxurious Protection for You and Your Family
Protects against perspiration, urine and fluids

SafeRest Renewal Mattress Pads offer protection against fluids, urine, perspiration and making them helpful for those with kids, pets or incontinence. As we sleep we shed thousands of dead skin cells, which can quickly accumulate. SafeRest mattress protectors trap dead skin cells on the surface of the protector where they can be easily washed away during quarterly launderings. This helps provide a cleaner sleep environment for you and your family.
Micro-Polyester and Viscose Rayon Derived From Renewable Bamboo - Breathable, Cool and Noiseless

To keep our protectors cool and noiseless, the surface material is made with soft polyester and viscose rayon derived from bamboo coated with a breathable and 100% waterproof membrane layer. The mixture of bamboo helps the protector/pad naturally resist moisture and is completely noiseless.
To ensure a great fit, an elastic band is used on the side skirt to automatically pull excess material under the mattress.
Machine-wash with your sheets using normal household detergents that do not contain bleach. Tumble dry on low heat. Do not iron.
Our mattress covers offer only slight padding producing an enhanced feel for any type of mattress including innerspring, latex or memory foam.
All SafeRest Renewal protectors are backed by a full replacement
contain no phthalates, vinyl or PVCs. ﻿
